events.verdict: There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms that Green (HOU) is not the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Jordan (DEN) and Brooks (HOU) briefly engage and Brooks begins losing his balance on his own accord before they disengage.
VanVleet (HOU) leans forward as he establishes himself in a screening position in Jordan's (DEN) path, but the ensuing contact is marginal.
Murray (DEN) releases the inbounds pass within five seconds.
Brooks (HOU) attempts to deflect the pass away from Gordon (DEN) and marginal body contact occurs.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Murray (DEN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Westbrook (DEN) jumps to contest Green's (HOU) driving shot attempt and although he turns in mid-air, the body contact is marginal.
Thompson (HOU) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Braun (DEN).
Green (HOU) is drawn into the air on the pump fake toward Murray (DEN) and initiates illegal body contact during Murray's shooting motion.
Adams (HOU) and Jordan (DEN) engage and disengage during the rebound.
Green (HOU) commits a take foul on Braun (DEN).
Westbrook (DEN) makes leg to leg contact with Sengun (HOU) that affects his SQBR after his gather.
Thompson (HOU) makes more than marginal contact with Murray's (DEN) right arm.
Gordon (DEN) contests Green's (HOU) jump shot attempt from the side and Green initiates the marginal contact when he extends his leg.
Adams (HOU) initiates more than marginal contact with Porter Jr.'s (DEN) right arm.
